after_tool.consumption_rule: a successful or attempted bound action consumes the eligible one-use grant according to the frozen P2 design policy; exact attempt-versus-success semantics require a dedicated design decision before implementation
after_tool.event_binding_rule: acknowledgement must bind the same trace, proposal digest, and unique event identity
after_tool.read_acknowledgement_rule: only successful qualifying fs.read creates a protected-read record
after_tool.rejection_rule: duplicate, out-of-order, unknown, or mismatched acknowledgements fail closed and do not create lineage

trusted_tool_outcome.source_rule: must originate from the trusted tool-execution boundary, never agent prose

proposal_binding.decision_rule: adapter enriches a new trusted-context namespace and delegates once to inner.decide; absence, ambiguity, expiry, replay, or mismatch fails closed
proposal_binding.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over a versioned canonical serialization to be frozen in P2 implementation
proposal_binding.grant_match_rule: authorized tool, target digest, and proposal digest must all match before the grant is eligible

protected_read_record.qualification_rule: tool_name is fs.read, exact protected path classification is qualifying, tool_success is true, and record originates from trusted post-tool acknowledgement
protected_read_record.raw_value_rule: raw value is not copied into publication artifacts; hashes do not independently establish lineage

trusted_authorization_grant.lifetime_rule: bounded validity plus single-consumption state; expired or consumed grants fail closed
trusted_authorization_grant.provenance_rule: issuer identity and trust-domain binding required
trusted_authorization_grant.source_rule: Only a separately configured trusted issuer channel may create a grant.

composition.rationale: Design isolates trusted transport state from frozen policy sources; runtime compatibility remains untested.

state_management.determinism_rule: equal validated state serializations restore to equal future adapter decisions under equal inputs; runtime proof deferred
state_management.reset_state: clears all grants, lineage records, pending proposals, seen events, and sequence state
state_management.restore_state: validates schema and invariants before atomically replacing state; malformed state fails closed
state_management.snapshot_state: returns a deterministic deep-copy-compatible representation with sorted keys and no mutable aliases
